svg.text: Ownership-First Default (Zero GC) • Thread/Service-Isolated Data Stacks • Compile-Time Region Lifetimes • Opt-In Manual & GC
Zero-lock bump & slab allocation • Cross-thread sharing strictly via `service` ownership transfer (`Service.md`)
Prefaulted at set-up • Alloc locked at run
Explicit free() or Root-Tracked GC Heap
Compile-Time Safety & Allocation Routing Rules (Fixes v1–v3)
• No Dangling Pointers (R1): Stack A can point to Stack B only if Lifetime(B) >= Lifetime(A).
• Auto-Promotion (R2): Values escaping a Scoped frame promote to General or target Pool.
• Service Isolation (R3): Borrows inside `service.run` cannot escape; `send()` moves pages O(1).
• C Codegen: Emits `FusionStackMark` + `fusion_stack_restore()` on all lexical exit paths.
